skills.name: Promo code summary
skills.description: Summarize orders that used a given promo code over the last 30 days.

skills.name: Monthly close report
skills.description: Generate a one-page financial summary for the most recently completed calendar month.

skills.name: Top customers by lifetime value
skills.description: Rank customers by lifetime order revenue. Useful for VIP outreach.

skills.name: Scrape a URL into the active theme
skills.description: Fetch a page, extract its layout and copy, scaffold a matching Fluid theme section.

skills.name: Theme accessibility audit
skills.description: Scan the active theme for common a11y issues and propose fixes.

skills.name: Optimize theme images
skills.description: Add responsive, lazy-loaded images and videos to Fluid Liquid themes with the media_tag filter (srcset/sizes/width/height/loading) and ImageKit transforms.

skills.name: Theme review & fix
skills.description: Iteratively review and fix a Fluid theme one section at a time: schema, Liquid correctness, performance, a11y, and DRY.

skills.name: Translate theme languages
skills.description: Translate a Fluid theme into every language the company has enabled, syncing locales/*.json with professional, on-brand localization.

skills.name: Scaffold a new Droplet for a Mist
skills.description: Set up the Droplet UI scaffolding (page, route, schema) for a fresh Mist app.

skills.name: Create Portal App
skills.description: Create a new Fluid portal using the same default screens, navigation, theme, and profile as fluid-admin.

skills.name: Audit env vars across all live Mists
skills.description: Check every live Mist for missing or inconsistent env vars (Stripe keys, webhook secrets, etc.).

skills.name: Debug a failed Mist deploy
skills.description: Pull deployment logs, identify the failure, and propose a fix.

skills.name: Theme Clone
skills.description: Clone any website into a pixel-perfect Fluid theme — scrape the source, build sections, push, and visually verify against the original.

skills.name: Theme Source Inventory
skills.description: Capture a fresh, machine-verifiable Home/Shop/PDP source bundle with exact copy, DOM, screenshots, and exhaustive image/video evidence before a Fluid theme build.

skills.name: Theme Refine
skills.description: Refine a Fluid theme to the gold standard: pixel-perfect visual QA after a clone, or migrate a legacy theme to the canonical architecture.

skills.name: Clone Page to Liquid
skills.description: Universal visual-copy engine for one source URL and one declared Fluid Liquid route: durable pixels/DOM, responsive implementation, managed preview, comparison, refinement, and honest evidence. Page-type skills supply semantics.

skills.name: Clone Home Page
skills.description: Reconstruct one storefront homepage in a Fluid theme with exact copy, responsive images and video, navigation states, and independently verifiable desktop/mobile evidence.

skills.name: Clone Shop Page
skills.description: Reconstruct a storefront's canonical shop/all-products listing in Fluid with a bounded real preview-data set, filtering, sorting, search, pagination, responsive behavior, and source evidence.

skills.name: Clone Product Page
skills.description: Recreate one source PDP as a Fluid Liquid product template using one source-backed preview product, canonical product data sections, gallery/options/price states, responsive behavior, and visual evidence.

skills.name: Clone Category Page
skills.description: Recreate a source category index or detail page as Fluid Liquid with bounded real preview data, category-specific templates, responsive list behavior, and visual evidence.

skills.name: Clone Collection Page
skills.description: Recreate a source collection index or detail page as Fluid Liquid with bounded real preview data, collection-specific templates, responsive merchandising behavior, and visual evidence.

skills.name: Onboarding Pre-Fill
skills.description: Pre-fill the Fluid payments onboarding (KYC) form by scraping the company website and researching public records, with confidence scoring before pushing. Also harvests the brand palette, typography and voice from the source site and writes the company brand.md.

skills.name: Fluid Product & Admin Import
skills.description: Import a complete source catalog and related store resources into the active Fluid company with evidence-backed discovery, immutable product and taxonomy identity, verified category and collection membership, resumable checkpoints, exact product fields, and strict one-to-one completion proof.

skills.name: UGC Discovery
skills.description: Find the 20-30 most engaging, FTC/FDA-compliant UGC posts about a brand or product across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Pinterest, let the user pick, and pull the picks into the DAM.

skills.name: Brand Social Content Import
skills.description: Import a company's OWN YouTube + TikTok videos into Fluid: find the official accounts, register them in social-media settings, and pull their videos into the DAM + Media. Not UGC — this is the brand's own content.

skills.name: Brand Setup
skills.description: Interview the company to build a living brand.md — a brand-voice document that Mist, themes, portals, and widgets read to match the company's tone and style. Prefills colors/name from brand guidelines and saves via the update_brand_voice tool. Also use to append a single brand decision later.

skills.name: Suggested Changes
skills.description: Review Lighthouse performance and compliance findings for this store, then approve or dismiss each recommended fix — approvals are applied and their impact is tracked.

skills.name: Open a Country
skills.description: Guided company-launch flow powered by Fluid's Country Atlas: pick the operating mode (NFR / OTG / USD), branch into mode-specific setup (operations status, entity, business id, warehouse), pick payment methods, missing languages, agreements, and enrollment fields, then run the open-country workflow with QA and chain the mode finalizer.

skills.name: Country Compliance Manager
skills.description: Audit a storefront against a country's legal requirements — disclosure pages, price display, cookie/privacy law, agreements, product labeling, storefront language — using the Country Atlas as the rulebook. Runs standalone and as the final step of the mode finalizers.

skills.name: Iterative Theme Refine
skills.description: Evidence-driven theme refinement after clone: each round compares semantic home/shop/PDP source landmarks against desktop and mobile previews, fixes the highest-impact root causes, and exits with a strict pass or itemized needs-review report.

skills.name: Smart Dashboard
skills.description: Self-fabricate a live business dashboard from real data — gather what every department cares about, render it with show_dashboard, then learn what the user wants front-and-center and remember it.

skills.name: 360-Assistant
skills.description: Build and run a named, company-specific storefront concierge: probe the platform, profile the catalogue into curated lanes, pick the assistant's name with the operator (three brand-derived candidates or their own, plus a rename path), create the app, then run it — recommendations that never surface spare parts, answers to a described problem ("my skin is dry") matched from the products' own descriptions with a hard medical guard, spare-part lookup, real carts (with a redirect for bundles the customer must configure), honest account signposting, and a no-dead-end voice that never says "I can't help with that".

skills.name: Checkout funnel diagnosis
skills.description: Diagnose where the cart-to-completed-order funnel is leaking using order-status buckets and payment approval trends, with a fix recommendation.

skills.name: Stalled order revenue recovery
skills.description: Rank orders stuck in draft/pending/pending_review by recoverable revenue and win probability, and hand over a call list.

skills.name: AOV lever audit
skills.description: Find which levers actually move average order value — item count, bundles, discount depth — with a dollar figure per lever.

skills.name: Rep signup momentum scoreboard
skills.description: Track rep/enrollment signup momentum by week and market, and surface the newest reps already active enough to be worth a personal spotlight.

skills.name: Clone Blog Page
skills.description: Recreate a source blog/journal index as the Fluid post_page route with real posts, author and date metadata, category filtering, and pagination. Finds blogs on subdomains, subpaths, or external platforms.

skills.name: Clone Post Page
skills.description: Recreate a source article detail page as the Fluid post route with dynamic body content, byline and date, rich body typography, inline media, and related-post rails.

skills.name: Clone Cart Page
skills.description: Recreate a source cart page or drawer as the Fluid cart_page route with real line items, recomputing totals, promo entry, empty state, and a working path to checkout.

skills.name: Clone System Pages
skills.description: Build the Fluid system routes a source rarely exposes — themed 404 and 503 error pages with full shell, plus the reusable generic content-page template.

skills.name: Brand From Source
skills.description: Read a company's public website once and set up its Fluid brand unattended: logo, app icon, favicon, OG image and description, primary and secondary colors, licensed fonts, and a first brand.md drafted from the site's own copy.

skills.name: Launch Setup
skills.description: Start an onboard: quality launches collect the source website, theme target, and confirmation in an in-chat picker before starting; speed launches keep the lightweight website-only path (it is also the onboarding workflows' Run-button launcher). Quality builds the whole store with Fable 5; speed builds the storefront only with Grok 4.5.
